title: Failed sends retry on their own
why: When a send fails nobody finds out for hours.

change.before: A failed send stays failed until someone presses send again.
change.after: A failed send retries on its own, and the outbox shows when it gave up.

mustHold: A message is never sent twice.
Retries stop after the configured limit.

decisions.decision: Retry three times, five minutes apart
decisions.reason: Covers a brief outage without hiding a real failure.

decisions.decision: Keep the attempt count on the outbox row
decisions.reason: The worker and the outbox then read the same number.

acceptance.criterion: A given-up send is easy to spot

check.judgment: Look at the outbox with one given-up send

units.title: Retry worker
units.goal: Retry failed sends up to the limit.

units.title: Gave-up label
units.goal: Show when a send gave up.
units.design: Adds one label; removing it restores the old row.
